title: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計
titleEn: Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail
summary: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計以「平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路線設計先建立平面與高程共同里程，再檢查曲率、坡度和變化率；地形可行的中心線仍可能因高速動態需求而需要更長緩和段。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Alignment design uses a shared chainage for plan and elevation before checking curvature, gradient and their rates; a terrain-feasible centreline may still require longer transitions for high-speed dynamics. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 圓曲線向心加速與曲線外矢估算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圓曲線向心加速」與「曲線外矢估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circular-curve acceleration" and "Curve versine estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圓曲線向心加速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circular-curve acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「圓曲線向心加速」如何影響高速鐵路路線平縱面設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circular-curve acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償。使用同里程速度及曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「圓曲線向心加速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.21 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation. Use speed and curvature at matching chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circular-curve acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「圓曲線向心加速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circular-curve acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圓曲線向心加速
knowledge.text: 向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21 m/s2。
knowledge.textEn: Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圓曲線向心加速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circular-curve acceleration" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題
向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把不同弦長外矢當同一幾何量會誤判曲率
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure.
Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Comparing versines from different chords misidentifies curvature.
quiz.explanation: 向心加速度隨速度平方增加並隨半徑增加而降低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Centripetal acceleration increases with speed squared and decreases with radius. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圓曲線向心加速：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「圓曲線向心加速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circular-curve acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.21 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.21 m/s2. Boundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.21 m/s2。模型邊界：等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「圓曲線向心加速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circular-curve acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只檢查圓曲線半徑會漏掉進出曲線的不平順
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：曲線正負號錯誤會顛倒輪重增加或減少
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Checking circular radius alone misses transition discomfort.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A curvature sign error reverses the inferred wheel-load trend.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=80 m/s, R=6400 m；y=v**2/R=1 m/s2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=80 m/s, R=6400 m; y=v**2/R=1 m/s2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 圓曲線向心加速：試驗與驗證
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「圓曲線向心加速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circular-curve acceleration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「圓曲線向心加速」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed sensor and alignment curvature data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Circular-curve acceleration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「圓曲線向心加速」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以同里程速度及曲率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Circular-curve acceleration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. Explain which evidence in speed and curvature at matching chainage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「圓曲線向心加速」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic speed sensor and alignment curvature data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Circular-curve acceleration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.text: 重算「圓曲線向心加速」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速圓周運動且半徑固定，不含超高補償如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以同里程速度及曲率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. Explain which evidence in speed and curvature at matching chainage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圓曲線向心加速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
options: 本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將角度與弧度混用會破壞座標積分
optionsEn: Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing degrees and radians corrupts coordinate integration.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以同里程速度及曲率區分模型與觀察，先用合成速度計與路線曲率資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use speed and curvature at matching chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圓曲線向心加速：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「圓曲線向心加速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circular-curve acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題。這個失效與「圓曲線向心加速」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同里程速度及曲率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure. This failure and a measurement bias in Circular-curve acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed and curvature at matching chainage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同里程速度及曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略速度變動會把幾何問題誤判為懸吊問題」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring speed variation can misidentify a geometry problem as suspension failure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲線外矢估算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
